blurb: Dashe Cellars is a family-owned artisan winery located in the heart of the Urban Wine Country in Alameda, CA. Founded by the husband and wife winemaking team of Michael and Anne Dashe, Dashe Cellars crafted its first vintage of Dry Creek Zinfandel in 1996.
